summary: Bundle E frontend E2E tested against the live preview URL as stealth (owner) on the 'Stealth Family' demo center. Groups tab (create parent+child, tree indentation, expand/collapse, edit, member add, archive+restore, search, tree/list view) all work. Calendar tab (Month/Week/Agenda views, prev/next/today nav, event create, conflict detection with override, event drawer, edit event, cancel with scope prompt) all work. Recurrence Daily with count=4 produced 4 occurrences visible in Agenda. Attendance tracking (per-attendee select, All present, Save) works. Task due-date projection: QA-weekly-013700 and QA-onetime-013657 show as red 'Deadline' entries in Agenda. Daily Work Digest card at /settings/account → Centers tab: toggle ON reveals hour select (default 8) and 7 include toggles; changed hour to 9 and it persisted after reload; toggle OFF works. Mobile (390x844): Calendar defaults to Agenda view, no horizontal overflow, Groups tab renders. Regression: Work/Members/Vault/Settings(lifecycle) tabs all still render. Overall Bundle E frontend is production-ready.

issues: When a row has action buttons (up/down/members/edit/archive) they wrap to a second line beneath the group name — usable but slightly cramped. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: A React dev-mode hydration warning fires ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') from RcUnitsTab.jsx line ~242 and similar <option> renderers. Root cause is Emergent's x-* instrumentation wrapping the {m.username} text expression inside <option> with a <span>. Doesn't break anything and won't appear in a production build, but could be silenced by rendering options as `<option key={..} value={..}>{`@${m.username}`}</option>` (already single-child template string, so probably fine) — or by adding `x-excluded` to those <option> elements. Very low priority.

Not tested: 'Convert to official assignment' flow (rc-drawer-convert-btn) — auditcheckreal is not a member of the demo center and inviting them would risk vault balance (~61 FP). Backend has 29/29 pytest coverage for this, and the UI wiring is small (RcConvertModal). Recommend a smoke-check by the main agent or a future iteration after seeding a member.

Not deep-tested: Task deadline pill click deep-link into Work tab drawer — the deadlines are visible in agenda but I did not click one; the code path (onOpenItem prop from ResponsibilityCenterDashboard) exists and looks correct.
